children: LME copper (MCU3=LX) may climb toward $14,888 per metric ton this week, following a break above resistance at $14,527.
The next resistance will be at $14,888, a break above which could lead to a gain into the $15,136-$15,473 range. A break below $14,527, now a support, could be followed by drop to $14,235.
The whole consolidation below $14,888 has taken the shape of triangle, which looks like a bullish continuation pattern, suggesting a target of $15,473.
* The copper report is published weekly on Monday.
